name: bounty-target-bootstrap
description: Bootstrap web, whitebox, Android, smart-contract, or native bounty targets from a program URL with rendered scope capture, source pull, lane fingerprinting, and environment readiness handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap bounty targets from host-provided scope
interface.longDescription: Use Playwright MCP to read a scope page, persist the normalized target in-repo, inventory smart-contract and service metadata, clone source or direct artifacts, assess local readiness, and prepare the next Bounty Hunting Program lane.
defaultPrompt: Open this bounty scope URL with Playwright and bootstrap the target locally
Normalize this Android scope page and download the in-scope APK artifacts
Clone the whitebox source repos from this program page and prepare the next bounty lane
Capture the host-provided smart-contract, explorer, ABI, and docs references from this bounty program page
Bootstrap this web or native target and make sure the local toolchain is ready before hunting starts
